q: Which industrial clusters are eligible for the ADEETIE scheme?
title: ADEETIE eligible clusters by sector
short: ADEETIE covers Udyam-registered MSMEs in 60 named clusters across 14 energy-intensive sectors, from Morbi ceramics and Firozabad glass to Ludhiana forging and Tirupur textiles. If your unit sits outside these clusters, it does not qualify in the first phase.
audience: MSMEs in energy-intensive clusters and their industry associations

ul: Bricks: Bengaluru, Begusarai, Indore, Nagpur, Tripura.
Chemicals: Ankleshwar and Panoli, Jamshedpur, Karnal, Thane, Vapi.
Food processing: Ganjam and Nayagarh, Kaithal, Ludhiana, Pune.
Forging: Bengaluru, Pune, Delhi-NCR, Chennai, Ludhiana.
Foundry: Batala, Jalandhar, Ludhiana, Howrah, Rajkot, Belgaum, Coimbatore.
Glass and refractory: Ambala, Chirkunda, East and West Godavari, Firozabad.
Leather: Kanpur, Kolkata, Pallavaram and Vaniyambadi, Jalandhar.
Paper: Muzaffarnagar-Saharanpur, Kashipur, Vapi, Coimbatore and Erode.
Pharma: Baddi, Medak, Madgaon, Ahmedabad, Bidar.
Steel re-rolling: Mandi Gobindgarh and Ludhiana, Jaipur, Jalna, Raipur.
Textile: Ludhiana, Surat, Tirupur, Solapur, Panipat.
Udyam registration and manufacturing operations inside the cluster.
A loan from a bank or financial institution for the project.
At least 10 percent energy savings from the chosen technology.

p: BEE's booklet says a second phase is planned for about 100 more clusters, based on learnings from the first 60. Until then, look at your state's efficiency schemes and SIDBI's energy saving loans.

senseible: Senseible reads twelve months of electricity bills and fuel invoices into a baseline of energy per tonne or per piece, the starting point an auditor needs to size a 10 percent saving.
